tables.cheque_schema_receipts: CREATE TABLE `cheque_schema_receipts` (`id` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,`version` varchar(32) NOT NULL,`plan_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(100) NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.cheque_issuing_banks: CREATE TABLE `cheque_issuing_banks` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,`name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_bank_code` (`code`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.cheque_instruments: CREATE TABLE `cheque_instruments` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`reference` varchar(100) NOT NULL,`client_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`client_snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`issuing_bank_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`drawer_name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`drawer_account_key` varchar(34) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,`number` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,`cheque_date` date NOT NULL,`received_date` date NOT NULL,`amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_reference` (`reference`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_identity` (`issuing_bank_id`,`drawer_account_key`,`number`),CONSTRAINT `cq_client` FOREIGN KEY (`client_id`) REFERENCES `v1_parties` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_issuer` FOREIGN KEY (`issuing_bank_id`) REFERENCES `cheque_issuing_banks` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_snapshot_json` CHECK (json_valid(`client_snapshot`)),CONSTRAINT `cq_positive` CHECK (`amount`>0)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.cheque_events: CREATE TABLE `cheque_events` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`cheque_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`ordinal` int unsigned NOT NULL,`type` enum('RECEIVED','DEPOSITED','CLEARED','DISHONOURED','RETURNED','CANCELLED') NOT NULL,`date` date NOT NULL,`bank_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,`reference` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,`evidence` varchar(1000) NOT NULL,`self_approval_reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,`previous_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`document_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,`batch_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_ordinal` (`cheque_id`,`ordinal`),CONSTRAINT `cq_event_instrument` FOREIGN KEY (`cheque_id`) REFERENCES `cheque_instruments` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_event_bank` FOREIGN KEY (`bank_id`) REFERENCES `money_accounts` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_event_doc` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `v1_documents` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_event_batch` FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `money_batches` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_event_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.cheque_audit: CREATE TABLE `cheque_audit` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`event_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`payload_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_audit_once` (`event_id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_audit_event` FOREIGN KEY (`event_id`) REFERENCES `cheque_events` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_audit_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.cheque_clearances: CREATE TABLE `cheque_clearances` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`cheque_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`event_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`batch_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`movement_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`instrument_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`event_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`document_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`batch_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`movement_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_claim_cheque_id` (`cheque_id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_claim_event_id` (`event_id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_claim_document_id` (`document_id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_claim_batch_id` (`batch_id`),UNIQUE KEY `cq_claim_movement_id` (`movement_id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_claim_cheque_id` FOREIGN KEY (`cheque_id`) REFERENCES `cheque_instruments` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_claim_event_id` FOREIGN KEY (`event_id`) REFERENCES `cheque_events` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_claim_document_id` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `v1_documents` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_claim_batch_id` FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `money_batches` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_claim_movement_id` FOREIGN KEY (`movement_id`) REFERENCES `money_movements` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `cq_claim_actor_id` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
